value: Roemer, J., Mungyeko Bisulandu, B.-J. R., Rousse, D. R., Pellerin, M., Bozorg, M., & Ilinca, A. (2026). Energy Consumption, Decarbonization Pathways, and Renewable Energy Integration in the Mining Industry: A System-Level Review. Energies, 19(8), 1890. https://doi.org/10.3390/en19081890

A narrative system-level review. Its tables are qualitative (case-study aims, microgrid lists, challenges), fuel and electricity prices, and storage characteristics; the only technology-level numbers are the Borden BEV case. Site energy figures are in _sector-intensity and may be useful for the mining annotation groups. Page locators are the journal page ('N of 44'), which equals the PDF page.
